The blank is "a hard-nosed" (or "a thoroughgoing"/"a consistent") empiricist: Austin is standardly described as a hard-nosed empiricist because he insisted that philosophy stay close to ordinary language and observable facts, rejecting grand metaphysical theorizing. His method of "linguistic phenomenology"—carefully examining what we say and when—reflects this empirical, anti-speculative stance.

CONFIDENCE: 70
